description: MyAreaReport helps users explore UK postcode, outcode, and place-based area intelligence inside ChatGPT. It retrieves official public data for crime, flood warnings, property prices, road traffic, and nearby fuel prices, then presents the results in a rich dashboard with deeper drill-down views.
